name: CSN 230 滑行灯暗 右主轮滑出跑道

cards.audioText:
B: Your call sign is CSN 230. The aircraft has just landed on Runway 02R of Baiyun Airport.
C: CSN 230, backtrack the runway, vacate the runway via A5.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 你的呼号是 CSN 230。飞机刚在 Baiyun Airport 跑道 02 right 落地。
C: CSN 230，在跑道上反向滑行，经 A5 脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Backtrack the runway, vacate the runway via A5, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在跑道上反向滑行，经 A5 脱离跑道，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, visibility 300 meters, low visibility procedure in effect, taxi with caution.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，能见度 300 meters，低能见度程序生效，谨慎滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, expedite vacating runway, traffic on short final. Contact Baiyun Ground on 120.2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，加速脱离跑道，短五边有活动。联系白云地面120.2。

cards.audioText: B: Now contact Baiyun Ground and tell him you have vacated runway
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在联系白云地面，告诉他你已脱离跑道。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, stand 35 via taxiway A5, A, G, E and Q.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，经滑行道 A5、A、G、E 和 Q 到 35 号机位。
cards.referenceText: A5, A, G, E and Q to stand 35, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A5、A、G、E 和 Q 到 35 号机位，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: B: You find the taxiway lighting is very dim, and ask for brightening them up.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你发现滑行道灯很暗，请求调亮。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Ground, CSN 230, can you turn up the taxiway lighting? It’s really dim.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN 230，能否调亮滑行道灯？灯光真的很暗。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, already on its maximum setting. Taxi with caution.
B: You tell controller that you need a detailed instruction.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 230，已经是最大设置。谨慎滑行。
B: 告诉管制员你需要详细指令。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request detailed taxi instruction, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求详细滑行指令，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, taxi straight ahead, I’ll keep you advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，直行滑行，我会持续给你提示。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, give way to the outbound traffic on your right, report have it in sight.
B: Tell him you have not found the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 230，给你右侧离场飞机让路，看到后报告。
B: 告诉他你没有看到该飞机。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, hold at present position. Traffic is crossing right to left.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，在当前位置等待。飞机正从右向左穿越。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, continue taxi, A is the first taxiway on your left.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，继续滑行，A 是你左侧第一条滑行道。
cards.referenceText: Left turn at first intersection, CSN 230.

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, follow taxiway A till next intersection, then right.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，沿滑行道 A 到下一个交叉口，然后右转。
cards.referenceText: Follow taxiway A, turn right at next intersection, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道 A，下一交叉口右转，CSN 230。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, you’ve taken a wrong turn. Now you are on EC.
B: Apologize to the controller, and ask him what you should do next.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 230，你转错了。现在你在 EC 上。
B: 向管制员道歉，并问他下一步该怎么办。
cards.referenceText: Sorry for that. Request further instruction, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 对此抱歉。请求进一步指令，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: Ah, CSN 230, continue taxi. Once reaching Cargo Apron, make a right 180. Make sure you have enough space to do it.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 嗯，CSN 230，继续滑行。到达货运机坪后右转 180。确认你有足够空间完成。
cards.referenceText: Roger, Cargo Apron, then right 180, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，货运机坪，然后右转 180，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: B: Tell him you have made a 180.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉他你已经完成 180。
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN 230，反向滑行完成。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, taxi eastward via previous route. Do not turn unless I call you.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，经原路线向东滑行。除非我呼叫你，不要转弯。
cards.referenceText: Eastward via previous route, straight ahead, CSN 230.

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, now turn right onto taxiway Q. Caution, taxiway is slippery.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，现在右转上滑行道 Q。注意，滑行道湿滑。
cards.referenceText: Turn right onto taxiway Q, CSN 230.

cards.audioText: B: Your right main gear skidded off the taxiway. Ask for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的右主起落架滑出滑行道。请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Ground, CSN 230, our right main gear skidded off the taxiway. Request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN 230，我们的右主起落架滑出滑行道。请求拖车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, copied that. Wait a minute.
